title: Communication Lost with Controller
shortDescription: IntelliFlo/IntelliPro pump lost comm with controller.
fullDescription:
Comm error appears when automation controller (IntelliCenter, EasyTouch) can't talk to the variable-speed pump. Usually RS-485 wiring or address.

Check wiring polarity, address switches, and termination.

fixSteps.title: Check wiring
fixSteps.instruction: Verify RS-485 A/B polarity and continuity.

fixSteps.title: Verify address
fixSteps.instruction: Pump address must match controller setup.

title: Drive Over Current
fullDescription:
Warning 4 indicates the drive detected excessive current. Often due to mechanical binding, impeller debris, or failing motor bearings.

Inspect pump wet end for debris or obstruction.

fixSteps.title: Clear impeller
fixSteps.instruction: Remove strainer basket, check impeller for debris.

title: Drive Over Temperature
fullDescription:
Drive electronics overheating. Check ambient temp, airflow around pump, and that drive cover is clean.

Pump will auto-restart after cooldown.

fixSteps.title: Clear vents
fixSteps.instruction: Remove debris from drive enclosure vents.

fixSteps.title: Shade
fixSteps.instruction: Provide sun shade if direct exposure.

title: Low Supply Voltage
fullDescription:
Supply voltage dropped below safe operating level. Usually utility brownout or shared circuit drawing heavy load.

Check voltage at pump terminals. Contact electrician if persistent.

fixSteps.title: Measure voltage
fixSteps.instruction: Test at pump terminals with multimeter.

fixSteps.title: Call electrician
fixSteps.instruction: If voltage consistently low, have wiring evaluated.

title: Pump Drive Fault
fullDescription:
Pump drive detected internal fault. Power cycle resets, but persistent fault requires drive replacement.

Service needed if persists.

title: Motor Over Current Trip
shortDescription: Motor drew more current than rated.
fullDescription:
Hard shutdown after persistent over-current. Indicates severe mechanical or electrical issue.

Inspect impeller, motor, and wiring.

faq.a: Over current is hard stop; Warning 4 is pre-alarm.

title: Motor Over Temperature
fullDescription:
Motor thermal sensor reports over-temperature. Pump shut down to cool.

Check for airflow, obstruction, and dead-head conditions.

fixSteps.title: Check airflow
fixSteps.instruction: Clear debris around motor and fan.

title: Severe Low Voltage
fullDescription:
Hard shutdown from low voltage. Common during storms or utility issues.

Wait for voltage to recover or call electrician.

faq.a: Pool pumps too large for UPS.

title: High Supply Voltage
fullDescription:
Supply voltage too high. Could damage drive. Shut down to protect.

Check utility and call electrician if persists.

title: High Pressure Detected
fullDescription:
High pressure switch activated. Usually dirty filter, closed valve, or solar system issue.

Backwash filter and verify valves.

fixSteps.title: Open valves
fixSteps.instruction: Check all return line valves are open.

title: Pump Did Not Prime
fullDescription:
Pump failed to move water after priming attempts. Air leak or water level issue.

Check water level, strainer lid seal, and suction plumbing.

fixSteps.title: Strainer lid
fixSteps.instruction: Fill strainer pot with water, lubricate and seal o-ring.

title: Service Required
fullDescription:
Pump reached an unrecoverable fault or service interval. Drive needs diagnostic evaluation.

Contact Pentair service.

faq.a: Only a tech can clear service codes.
